name: ai-purchasing-agent
description: AI purchasing agent that makes, executes and validates purchase decisions

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @purchasing/server" "npm run dev -w @purchasing/client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @purchasing/shared && npm run test -w @purchasing/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @purchasing/shared && npm run typecheck -w @purchasing/server && npm run typecheck -w @purchasing/client
